placements.title: Tiering retention between perishable raw recordings and permanent transcripts
placements.frame: How should raw observational media and distilled records be lifecycle-managed over time?
placements.why: Establishes institutional policy of bounding raw audio retention to eighteen months while preserving transcripts permanently.

placements.title: Grounding operational diagnostics in frontline inquiry before management
placements.frame: How should diagnostic timelines and stakeholder interview sequences be structured to uncover system reality?
placements.why: Sets a two-week diagnostic duration and prioritizes warehouse frontline engagement ahead of management interviews.

placements.title: Anchoring seasonal operations to environmental thresholds rather than rigid calendars
placements.frame: When should critical agricultural and cultivation tasks be scheduled relative to weather risks?
placements.why: Fixes orchard grafting timing to late March specifically conditional on the conclusion of seasonal frosts.
